verdict.rationale: Railway documents its own programmatic surfaces: an official CLI and an MCP server that lets AI assistants create projects, deploy templates, manage environments, pull variables, and redeploy services. These cover only a listed subset of operations, and the pack never documents a public API or claims parity with the dashboard. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, so no machine-readable API spec was found. Missing for 10: a documented public API, evidence that every UI action (canvas settings, dashboards, alerts, scaling, rollbacks) is exposed programmatically, an API reference or spec, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
